title: Website Redesign & Development RFP — Accountability Lab
snippet: Accountability Lab is seeking proposals from qualified vendors to redesign and rebuild its global nonprofit website with improved UX, accessibility, and performance.

title: Request for Proposals: Website Development — IPPF
snippet: As part of a broader global rebrand launching in early November 2025, IPPF is developing a new website to reflect its renewed identity, purpose, and vision. The agency selected through this RFP will be expected to collaborate closely with the rebrand team to develop the new website and to integrate the new brand assets, design system, and messaging into the website.

title: Website Redesign RFP — City Procurement (Willow Springs)
snippet: The City of Willow Springs is seeking proposals for a website redesign and the implementation of a hosted web content management solution. The goal is to create a more appealing, interactive, and user-friendly website that extends city services online and minimizes paperwork. The new website will be hosted by the selected vendor.

title: Marketing & Outreach Consultant RFP — SeamlessAccess
snippet: SeamlessAccess is looking for a Marketing & Outreach Consultant to take on a project that will strengthen and professionalize SeamlessAccess’ marketing and outreach efforts.

title: Request for Proposals: Implementation Support for the 2026 Strategic Plan — Enterprise Community Partners
snippet: Enterprise Community Partners is seeking a qualified firm to support implementation of its 2026–2030 Strategic Plan by providing project management, coordination, progress tracking, and governance support across multiple workstreams. The engagement runs from February 1, 2026 to December 1, 2026 with a $20,000+ scale-style nonprofit consulting scope delivered via SlideRoom submission.
